summary: Executed backend + frontend regression testing for live header/site/page editors, content-sync safety, and auth/session behavior. Core backend suites passed; frontend exposed critical header computed-style regressions despite successful saves.

ui_bugs.issue: Saved header style values do not reliably apply as computed styles. After saving backgroundColor=#efe6d8 and brandFontSize=27px, computed header background stayed white and brand/subtitle font sizes varied by page (home/craft/workshops/rakhigarhi) instead of using configured values.
Saved navBackgroundColor did not reflect in computed nav background (remained transparent across tested pages).

integration_issues.issue: Repeated /api/auth/me 401 console entries observed; behavior appears expected probe pattern and was non-blocking.

action_items: Fix header computed-style precedence so saved header background/nav background/brand and subtitle sizes apply consistently on all public pages.
Validate interaction between HeaderStyleTag and existing page/reference typography rules (including any !important rules and SiteText/text_styles overrides).
After fix, re-run cross-page computed-style assertions for Home/Craft/Workshops/Rakhigarhi and dropdown state.
Confirm whether empty text_styles entries should be deleted on reset-save (display.notes-title currently persisted with styles:{}).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend live-page endpoint now correctly returns full published section sets including hidden sections; unauthorized access properly denied with a fresh anonymous client.
Three-way content sync tests in isolated Mongo DBs remain stable: backup-first apply, rollback on fault injection, idempotent no-op, and sentinel collection protection all passed.
Header style save path returns success, but UI computed-style results indicate frontend style precedence/selector conflict rather than backend persistence failure.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed tests passed (42 passed, 2 skipped across executed suites)
success_rate.frontend: ~72% targeted flows passed (login, dock, header content/menu save+restore, notes-title style save/reset, page text-size save/reload/reset, responsive overflow, logout hide dock passed; header computed-style consistency failed)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Isolated temporary Mongo DBs used by content-sync tests were dropped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview content was restored for edited header content/menu and page heading style. Header styles were reset and saved. Validate if display.notes-title empty style object existed before this run; reset currently leaves styles:{} entry. Reproduce CRITICAL issue with saved header styles: background/nav bg/brand-subtitle sizes not matching computed output across pages.
rca of the issue: Repro: login owner -> Edit Header -> set background/nav bg/font sizes -> Save header -> open Home/Craft/Workshops/Rakhigarhi and read computed styles on #site-header/.brand-name/.brand-sub/.nav-list. Observed: position/padding/minHeight/nav font family/size applied, but header background/nav background/brand/subtitle sizes are overridden/inconsistent by page. Likely root cause is stronger per-page typography/layout CSS (or text-style overrides) still outranking parts of HeaderStyleTag rules. Mitigation: tighten selectors for all targeted header elements (including specific background-color targets for header/nav wrappers and explicit brand/subtitle selectors), and add regression assertions on computed styles, not only style-tag presence.
